segments.text: hello thank you for allowing me an
opportunity to speak just making my
notes here please
so tonight thank you
about a comment that was made by mayor
Gonzalez
at the candidate Forum last week
as a resident of this city who owns a
home and spends my dollars here
I am appalled absolutely appalled by
your comment that you are for the true
community
when I stopped and reflected on this
comment Not only was I angry I was hurt
I was embarrassed and quite frankly I
was disgusted
but I was genuinely more concerned
about the direction of the city is the
city is headed in
you see looking at your past
your present actions and the words you
speak they're consistent
with these two words
true community
you want to keep the city in the dark
you have said it yourself you want to
stay traditional
as a member of this community this is
what I heard and I'm not alone
you want to be non-inclusive
you want no growth
and are unwelcoming
so others like me who choose made a
conscious choice
to move to the city to make it our home
means nothing to you that is the message
that is being communicated
you may not think
people are watching
or hearing about what you are doing to
this city because meetings like tonight
hardly anybody is here but let me tell
you there are people watching and they
watch online
I may not come every month to this
meeting but I can tell you
I watch it I listen I do my research I
look at the agendas and I look at what's
on what you guys are talking about on
the calendar
and I also encourage others to do the
same
because an informed City in an informed
resident is a much better constituent
for our city
now all of this that is going on really
makes me question
is there quid pro quo going on
because clearly there's favoritism that
is clearly shown and if that is and if
you're turning a blind eye to it then
that's really unfortunate
there's also most likely in my opinion a
gift of public funds being distributed
so maybe it's time
that this city and the residents maybe
it's time we need to ask for a state
audit of what is going on with our city
and what is going on with our funds and
what is going on with our general funds
before it's too late and we become
another city and another statistic
that's going to be plastered all over
the news because of the mismanagement
your accomplishments not goals and let
me clarify that for you cater to the
true community
and yourself
not for the residents not for the city
and not for the community
don't ever forget each one of you
sitting here on this Council you work
for us the residents
we have the power
and of our voices and we have the power
of our votes
so it's important that you start looking
at the community as a whole and not as
just a true community
you all need to do better
need to be accountable for each one of
you not just let's go with the bandwagon
I would expect Beckwith to have his own
thoughts Alvarez to have his own
thoughts Mendez to have his own thoughts
and Alvarez for you to have your own
thoughts
you need to be accountable to the
residents of the city from the north
from the south
from the East and from the West
inclusive everybody
not just who you like or don't like
Mr Mayor no apology will be accepted by
me and probably many others because they
are just words that do not match your
actions
your true colors have been seen
and let me tell you
we are all watching
thank you
